description: RJ-40 represents the District Transport Office (DTO) in Bhiwadi, an essential industrial hub in Rajasthan. This office was established to manage the high volume of vehicle registrations and commercial transport permits generated by the Bhiwadi industrial cluster and its surrounding areas.
address: District Transport Office, Bhiwadi, C-51, 52 Bhagat Singh Colony, Alwar, Rajasthan - 301019
